title: Pixel Done
description: He built the first version of Pixel Done in a single day in late June 2026, during a break from final-exam revision. Studying software engineering and curious about Android development, he turned the idea into a bold experiment in Vibe Coding—working with GPT-5.5 to sharpen his AI-assisted development workflow while exploring an unfamiliar stack. He carried the app through the full mobile product lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment and maintenance, sharing it with classmates on Android and iterating on their suggestions. Pixel Done centers on to-do management, with task and checklist editing, customizable Dock shortcuts, cloud backup, and cross-device sync.
period: Late June 2026 · initial version built in one day
role: Product design, Vibe Coding development, distribution and ongoing maintenance
